I couldn't set up the recurring 07:45 brief. I don't have a scheduling tool, so nothing would post tomorrow (15 Oct) or on later mornings.

I replied to you in the #strategic-random thread with two options:
1. **On-demand:** ask me in #strategic-random each morning and I'll post that day's brief. I can read all three channels.
2. **Scheduled:** someone with platform scheduling access sets up a daily 07:45 Chicago-time job, and I write the brief to your format.

The reply also covers two constraints on the brief:
- It will leave out money terms (rates, prices, contract values) from #strategic-pod, because June Osei-Lark isn't in #strategic-random.
- It would post only in #strategic-random. Its members (you, Gideon Sato, Nadia Fennimore) are already in all three source channels, so it wouldn't expose anything new.

I also offered to post a sample brief for today so you can check the format. I haven't posted one yet.
